email.body1:
Craig, saw mabl shipped the agentic testing platform with Active Coverage on the back of a 700% jump in GenAI usage.

A new platform usually surfaces more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for mabl off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Craig, quick follow-up for mabl.

As VP of Sales you feel coverage pressure first: more in-market accounts than the team can touch as the new platform expands the addressable base. Most teams cannot actually say how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings mabl needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Craig, last bit of proof for mabl.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how mabl's reply rate likely compares to peer dev-tools teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Craig, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Launching an agentic platform is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to mabl either way.
